name: Cafe Restaurant Alte Schmiede
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Café Restaurant Alte Schmiede in Tirol**

Nestled in the heart of the **Alpenland Tirol**, our cozy **Café Restaurant Alte Schmiede** invites you to savor authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a charming, rustic setting. Just a short stroll from the vibrant center of **Innsbruck**, we offer a perfect blend of traditional charm and modern comfort.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized layers of pancake torn into tender pieces, served with fresh fruit compote or a dusting of powdered sugar. Pair it with a steaming cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** soup or a hearty **Schlutzkrapfen** (spinach and ricotta dumplings) in rich gravy.

For lunch, enjoy a classic **Tiroler Gröstl**—a hearty mix of potatoes, onions, and crispy bacon, topped with a perfectly fried egg. Our **Kaspressknödel** (cheese dumplings) are a must-try, served with a savory mushroom sauce or creamy spinach.

Afternoon tea lovers will adore our selection of **Tiroler Spezialitäten**—from buttery **Ausgezogene** (stretched cheese) to delicate **Topfenstrudel** (quark strudel) with vanilla sauce. Wash it down with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Apfelsaft** (apple juice) or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** from local breweries.

In the evening, unwind with a **Tiroler Schnaps** or a glass of **Graubündner Wein** (Graubünden wine) while enjoying our warm **Kaiserschmarrn** or a comforting **Gulasch** with fresh bread.

Our terrace offers breathtaking views of the **Nordkette** and the **Inn Valley**, making every meal an unforgettable experience. Whether you're exploring **Tirol’s** stunning landscapes or seeking a taste of its rich culinary traditions, **Alte Schmiede** is your home away from home.

**Come visit us in the historic heart of Innsbruck—where tradition meets warmth!**
